P01.rationale: There is no founder portrait or human anchor present on this page.

P05.rationale: No case study portraits are visible; the layout contains only text and a single background image of a worker.

P07.rationale: There is no social-proof apparatus such as logos, ratings, or testimonials displayed.

P10.rationale: No oversized decorative typographic elements like ghost numerals are present; the layout relies on standard headings.

P11.rationale: There are no data visualisations or charts bound to numbers in this text-heavy layout.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with substantial copy blocks.

P13.rationale: The background is a flat dark overlay without any intentional texture or atmospheric grain.

P14.rationale: While the text is readable due to high contrast against the darkened photo, it lacks specific treatment like a scrim or vignette to ensure legibility across the whole image.

P16.rationale: No device mockups are shown; the only object visible is a phone held by the person in the background.

N07.rationale: The imagery of the construction worker appears generic and stock-like rather than specific to a real business context.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace as the text blocks are tightly packed against the edges and background image.

N10.rationale: The white text sits directly on top of a busy photo without sufficient darkening or masking to ensure readability in all areas.
